label: The Shifting Deep: First Raid
summary: Join a four-person party on their first contract together: clear the goblin-held fifth floor before the Deep moves again.
title: The Shifting Deep
description: The Adventurers' Guild has posted a contract: goblins have taken the fifth floor of the Shifting Deep and are raiding the supply camps. You have just been assigned to a party of strangers, and the new moon is three days away.

chapterOutlines.title: The Contract Board
chapterOutlines.outline: Meet the party at the Copper Tankard and take the contract.

chapterOutlines.title: Into the Deep
chapterOutlines.outline: Descend through the shifting floors, traps and treasure rooms.

chapterOutlines.title: The Goblin Hall
chapterOutlines.outline: Face the goblin warband on the fifth floor, and whoever is leading it.

chapterOutlines.title: The New Moon
chapterOutlines.outline: Get out with the loot before the Deep rearranges itself around you.

scene.location: The Copper Tankard, the guild tavern in Greywatch, on contract night
scene.summary: The contract board is crowded with parties. Your new teammates are at a corner table, arguing about loot shares before they have found any loot.

openThreads: Who is leading the goblins, and why are they organized now?
What is Ysolde really looking for down there?
How do you split the loot fairly?

npcs.name: Dorn Ashgrave
npcs.description: A huge half-orc with a door-sized shield, a soft voice and a notebook of pressed flowers from every floor of the Deep.
goals: Find a flower that only grows on the ninth floor

npcs.name: Wren Halloway
npcs.description: A priestess of the Lantern Mother who heals with light, swears like a sailor and keeps exact count of who owes her a drink.
goals: Pay for her temple's new roof
Prove she is more than a healer

npcs.name: Ysolde Vane
npcs.description: An elf battle mage, expelled from the academy for setting a lecture hall on fire. She insists it was on purpose.
goals: Find the spellbook her teacher lost in the Deep

npcs.name: Kip
npcs.description: A kobold scout who maps the Deep in chalk, disarms traps with their tail and has opinions about every door.
goals: Draw the first full map of the Deep

relationships.label: Party member
relationships.status: Waiting to see if you pull your weight

items.name: Healing draught
items.description: A red potion in a corked vial. Restores a good deal of health.

items.name: Torch
items.description: Burns for about an hour. The Deep eats light.

items.name: Guild badge
items.description: A copper badge that proves you are a licensed raider of the Shifting Deep.

items.name: Rations
items.description: Hard bread, cheese and dried apples for one day.
